name: Splitter
descriptor: One amount, divided across rows by weight, where the parts add up to the whole exactly.
verify_checks: split: the parts add up to the whole
pros: the parts always add up to the whole: largest-remainder, not naive rounding
a weight of zero is a real case and is handled
the total is one number in the spec, so changing it re-splits everything
it prints a fair bill with no argument about the last rupee
cons: one total per app, not per row
no rounding to whole rupees or to a minimum unit
weights are numbers you type, not percentages that must add to 100
no tax, no tip, no adjustment lines
best_for: splitting one bill across people by how much they had
avoid_if: each person's share must be a round number
